instruction: The precondition FreeCAD file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open the chain model in FreeCAD and run a tension-force FEM analysis along the major axis of the elliptical loop. Use material Iron-Generic, apply 20 kN force on the major axis, create a 3D Gmsh FEM mesh with maximum size 1 mm and minimum size 0.5 mm, run the CalculiX solver, generate CCX_Results, Pipeline_CCX_Results, and ccx_dat_file, add a warp vector filter to display displacement magnitude under load, save the min/max condition CCX result to /home/user/result.csv, and save the completed FreeCAD document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
